sources.note: Lenkau is NOT one of the eight sketched languages (Table 0.1: 4.5 contact hours, 2 days). Lenkau appears only as comparanda (Pak sketch 7.7: numerals sip, huep, trilip, trolotr, nguran; colour terms kahan, kohow, hamaman, angoan, tahin; Loniu sketch pronoun table). Stress statements in these sketches concern Pak, Nauna, Loniu only; nothing on Lenkau stress.

sources.citation: Blust, Robert. 1975 [deposited 2014]. Field notebooks RB2-011, Admiralty Islands survey: Lenkau packet pp. 344-355 (language no. 24; speaker Nineh Dumoil, age 13, Lenkau village; 10-11 April 1975, 4.5 contact hours). Kaipuleohone, University of Hawai'i, hdl:10125/33171.

sources.note: PRIMARY DATA ONLY, all 12 pages viewed. Handwritten phonetic wordlist (Tok Pisin master list 1-749), paradigms, numerals and a few sentences; acute stress marks sporadic and mixed: penultimate/initial in huwep 'two', tilip 'three', trolotr 'four', nguran 'five', enep 'six', tohos, suweh, epi, moso, apuwah, kokoman, kapah, puli, aloah, hohowat, horung, merih; final in kahan 'black', kohow 'white', hamaman 'red', minan(i). The only phonological prose is p. 344 '(/t/ is a palatal stop /i__)'. No statement about stress.
